description: stopPropagation in a capture-phase listener ends the dispatch at its invocation (DOM standard: one per node and phase), as Chromium does: the node's own bubbling listeners do not run, at the target its non-capture listeners (registered before the capture ones too) do not run, stopImmediatePropagation also skips the rest of the invocation, and a stop at the container (Svelte's delegation root, IR schedule.delegation) keeps every delegated template handler from running; a template `onclickcapture` that stops keeps its element's script bubbling listener and the delegated handlers from running. Physical clicks, a nested click() and a script dispatchEvent of a MouseEvent take the same path
